parent_inputs_read: Gate0 001C bounded isolated predictive-action mechanism evidence only
future_problem_definition: Can a bounded process/intervention mechanism show intervention-sensitive internal update and later behavior change that cannot be reproduced by fair full-history and online cheap controls under the same access contract?
intervention_contract_summary: Future card must freeze state deletion, memory deletion, representation freezing, prediction-error injection, counterfactual action substitution, observation perturbation, history-preserving causal perturbation, and online distribution shift.
trace_replay_contract_summary: Future traces must expose intervention condition, counterfactual probes, state before/after update, state_delta, memory reads/writes, retrieval hits, resource usage, output, future behavior probe, verifier outcome, access manifest, and lineage id.
control_adversary_summary: Future task must include full-history and online count/statistic, FSM, graph/cache, kNN/episodic, summary/statistic, causal table, behavior-only replay, trace-only replay, graph/cache trace generator, random representation, shuffled label/outcome, and oracle/leakage probes.
resource_contract_summary: Resource limits are symmetric accounting only; witness and controls receive comparable resource budgets and controls must not be starved.
collapse_audit_summary: Future executable preflight fails if any fair cheap control reproduces intervention response, internal update trace, and later behavior change, or if traces are decorative.
anti_hardcoding_audit_summary: Future task must reject renamed variables, if-else policy disguised as mechanism, decorative traces, control banning, resource asymmetry, and oracle access.
